news.title: Monroe policy renews debate about trans athletes in Michigan schools
news.summary_en: A Monroe Public Schools policy that blocks transgender girls from participating on its girls sports teams renews concern and legal questions about the civil rights of student athletes.
news.author: Katee Tompkins, Capital News Service

news.title: Majority of Michigan school bonds pass in Nov. election. Look up your district
news.summary_en: Forty-two school bonds were on Tuesday’s ballot. About 60% passed.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
